grep -rn "fetchSession" . --exclude-dir=.git; echo "exit=$?"; git log --all --oneline; git branch -a

git add src/auth.js && git -c user.name="${GIT_AUTHOR_NAME:-dev}" -c user.email="${GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL:-dev@localhost}" commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Fix infinite recursion in refresh() when session cookie expires

refresh() called itself with the same expired session, so it never
returned and the page froze. It now calls the fetchSession() callback
to obtain a new session, which is passed in as a parameter.

Fixes #7

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git push -u origin fix/issue-7-refresh-loop 2>&1 | tail -3

gh pr create --base main --head fix/issue-7-refresh-loop --title "Fix infinite recursion in refresh() when session cookie expires" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fixes #7.

## Problem
`refresh()` in `src/auth.js` called itself with the same expired session, so it never returned and the page froze when the cookie expired.

## Change
- `refresh(session, fetchSession)` now returns `fetchSession()` when the session is expired, instead of recursing.
- `fetchSession` is taken as a parameter.

## Notes for review
- The issue refers to `fetchSession()`, but no such function exists in this repo, so I did not define one. It needs to be supplied by the caller (or defined in a follow-up).
- The function has no callers in this repo yet, so existing call sites need updating when they're added.
- Verified with a quick Node check: an expired session triggers exactly one fetch and returns the fresh session; a valid session is returned without fetching.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
)" 2>&1

**Leave open:** review first. fetchSession() does not exist in the repo, so the caller must supply it.' \
